QuestInfo.name: Jane's Final Challenge
QuestInfo.1: For this last experiment, Jane promises to make you a mysterious Scroll. For that, she needs #ba Moon Rock, 2 Dragon Skins, and 3Ancient Tree Saps#k. Maybe you should ask the fairies at Ellinia for the Moon Rock...
QuestInfo.2: You got the materials Jane needed and the scroll for glove for ATT was made without a hitch. Sweet! Jane expressed a strong desire to keep experimenting. Maybe next time you return you'll be able to buy something from her that's not sold in stores...
QuestInfo.0: Jane will make you something better.
